name: bank-feed
description: Read-only bank account information (PSD2 AIS via Enable Banking), the finance data tools, and local transaction annotations (tags, notes) with note search, batch annotation and spend-by-tag aggregation, and deterministic auto-tagging rules applied at ingest.

protectedTools.name: unlink_bank
protectedTools.summary: Revokes the Enable Banking consent identified by {consent_ref}. Refresh stops for that bank's accounts until it is re-linked. Local history is not erased.

protectedTools.name: purge
protectedTools.summary: Permanently deletes every transaction booked before {before_date}, across all accounts, then reclaims the file space. This cannot be undone.

protectedTools.name: forget_local_account
protectedTools.summary: Erases account {account_id} locally: transactions, balances, coverage, sync state. Nothing is revoked -- this does NOT disconnect the bank. Cannot be undone.

protectedTools.name: delete_all_data
protectedTools.summary: Erases the ENTIRE local finance ledger for every linked account: every transaction, balance, session and sync record. The most destructive of these actions. Cannot be undone.

protectedTools.name: label_account
protectedTools.summary: Changes account {account_id}'s label, category or included status. Excluding it removes the account from every balance and transaction total shown until it is re-included.

protectedTools.name: accept_app_reregistration
protectedTools.summary: Authorizes setup_bank_feed to REGISTER A REPLACEMENT Enable Banking application because the previously bound one vanished from the control panel. Every bank must be re-linked afterwards.
